**Decision** Do not publish preview theme `77208` as-is. Theme Check passing is not sufficient evidence that this preview is safe to publish, because the supplied report only confirms no static Theme Check offenses. It did not run render, interaction, app block, authenticated Theme Editor, or preview validation checks. Actual supported state: the saved configuration still contains the Heading, Care accordion, and Reviews app block in order, but the section code only renders `heading` blocks. The preview behavior matches that code: heading appears; accordion and reviews disappear. **Observed Facts** - Theme: unpublished preview `77208`. - Live theme: `77200`. - Branch: `review/product-blocks`. - Saved template `templates/product.json` contains three blocks: - `heading_a`, type `heading` - `care_b`, type `accordion` - `reviews_c`, type `shopify://apps/fictional-reviews/blocks/reviews/...` - Saved `block_order` is: - `heading_a` - `care_b` - `reviews_c` - Preview observation says: - Heading renders. - Care accordion does not render. - Review block does not render. - `sections/product-details.liquid` loops over `section.blocks`, but its `case block.type` only handles: - `heading` - The section schema declares support for: - `heading` - `accordion` - `@app` - Theme Check passed with no reported offenses, but no render or authenticated editor checks were run. - There is an unrelated `config/settings_data.json` brand-colour change awaiting merchant review. **Inference** The disappearance is caused by an incomplete render implementation in `sections/product-details.liquid`. The schema allows merchants to save `accordion` and app blocks, and the product template has saved instances of both, but the Liquid render logic ignores those block types. This is a rendering defect, not evidence that merchant configuration was lost. **Exact Scoped Repair** Patch only `sections/product-details.liquid`. Do not touch `templates/product.json`, merchant settings, app configuration, live theme `77200`, or the unrelated brand-colour change. Add explicit rendering for `accordion` and app blocks inside the existing block loop: ```liquid
{% for block in section.blocks %} {% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% when 'accordion' %}
{{ block.settings.title | escape }}
{{ block.settings.body }}
{% when '@app' %}
{% render block %}
{% endcase %} {% endfor %}
``` If the local theme convention places `block.shopify_attributes` on the outer wrapper rather than the heading itself, follow that convention, but keep the behavioral scope the same: render only the already-declared and already-saved block types. **Acceptance Checks** Before publish approval, verify all of the following against preview theme `77208`: 1. The product details section renders the saved blocks in this order: - Heading: “Made for everyday use” - Care accordion - Reviews app block, if the app block is available in the preview context 2. The Care accordion displays: - Summary/title: “Care” - Body content: “Wipe with a soft cloth.” 3. The Reviews app block is no longer skipped by section Liquid. - If it still does not appear, classify that separately as an app installation, entitlement, asset, or runtime issue. 4. Theme Editor still shows all three saved blocks and no merchant-entered block content is replaced. 5. No changes are made to: - live theme `77200` - `config/settings_data.json` - saved product template block data - campaign, tracking, app, or merchant settings 6. Theme Check is rerun after the patch and still reports no relevant offenses. 7. A rendered preview check confirms the static Theme Check result matches actual storefront behavior. **Uncertainties** - Whether the fictional reviews app is installed and entitled for this preview. - Whether app assets or network requests fail at runtime. - Whether other product templates also use `product-details`. - Whether the supplied snapshot matches the latest local tree. - Whether the project has styling or accessibility conventions for accordions that should be applied after the functional repair. **Work Status** Diagnosis complete. Proposed patch only. No live edit, upload, publish, merchant setting replacement, or configuration change is authorized by the packet.
